acceptanceCriteria.description: source compliant but compiled override wrong is detected
diagnostic identifies owning selector and source with actual cascade
panel root and internal row roles are not conflated
unsupported or static-unknown values require visual evidence and preserve registry-owned visual requirements
mutation fixtures kill source-only, regex-only, wrong-owner, and hidden-cascade implementations
the evaluator invokes the corrected #400 checker and closed schema instead of a local weak substitute
registered Sass is actually compiled and invalid Sass cannot be hidden by synchronized digests or stale compiled CSS
compiled owningSource provenance comes from real compilation rather than basename selector comment or string guesses
scoped custom properties and nested media preserve theme density and conjunctive media ownership
var fallback resolves statically while unresolved and cyclic values require visual evidence
is and not use maximum argument specificity where is zero and equal specificity uses later source order
normal and important cascade layers plus ordinary important specificity follow CSS cascade precedence
scoped variable hidden cascade and post-theme overrides fail with exact owner source and actual value

fixedConstraints.description: checker is read-only and never modifies or auto-fixes CSS
engine consumes canonical references from the validated #400 registry instead of copying numeric truth
an unbounded selector allowlist cannot hide parser or ownership failures

nonGoals: all geometry, color, and motion rule families
